_note: Stage 1 of parity bug B (task #39): sanity-floor the block-continuation pitch reference in parse_pdfium. Diagnosis is docs/evidence/pdfium-block-synthesis-2026-08-05.json and is not re-derived here. `before` is the same tree with PITCH_FLOOR_EM = 0.0, which makes _pitch_reference the identity -- verified to reproduce the pre-change numbers on every signature document. Both measured in the canonical container, same corpus, same profile. This record is a measurement, not an authorisation.

threshold.statistic: the block-continuation reference divided by the text size that will be tested against it (ref/size, in em)
threshold.instrument: _build_blocks_one wrapped in place, so the real _column_split above it still chose the groups. The diagnosis records why: a census that re-sorts a page's blocks by (y, x) before re-running assembly interleaves the columns BY CONSTRUCTION.
threshold.population: 3291 (page, column-group, size) buckets carrying ~105000 lines, over all 29 expansion + 16 gated documents on the candidate arm

distribution_line_weighted._note: Broad and shallow between 0.35 and 1.05 across the whole corpus -- this is NOT the clean two-lobe separation MARGIN_MISCLUSTER_PT enjoyed, and the floor is not claimed to be one.

why_0_5_em: Physical, not fitted: a line of size S cannot advance by half its own em. Solid setting is 1.0em and is already rare; the corpus's modal leading is 1.10-1.20em.
On the GATED 16 -- the only corpus that authorises anything -- the statistic is EMPTY between 0.422em and 0.647em. 0.5 sits inside that gap with 0.078em of margin below and 0.147em above.
Insensitive: floors of 0.45, 0.50 and 0.60 give y06 12284 / 12254 / 12214 blocks, and defaults of 1.00, 1.15 and 1.30 give 12345 / 12254 / 12218. The result is not knife-edge tuned.
threshold.why_default_1_15_em: The line-weighted mode of the healthy references. It has to clear y06's true 11.50pt in-column pitch at size 10 -- 1.15 * 1.15 = 1.32em admits it -- without reaching a paragraph boundary, which on that document is pitch plus at least half a line again.

fallback_order: the size bucket's own 20th percentile, unchanged, whenever it clears the floor
the page-wide 20th percentile, if THAT clears the floor -- a different sample, and often healthy when a bucket is not
safety_property: The function can only ever RAISE a reference, so it can only ever JOIN lines. A unit test asserts this over a grid of sizes and references rather than arguing it.
what_it_does_not_do: It does not detect columns. Two columns that interleave without overlapping horizontally are refused by the `overlap > 0` term before the pitch is consulted, so no pitch fix reaches them -- that is the N-column split's job. This guard makes a column-split failure survivable rather than fatal, and the magnitude below is bounded by exactly that.

signature_documents_candidate_arm._note: parse+infer only, both arms, at the profile above. `blocks`/`paras` are whole-document counts; l/blk and l/para are lines per block and source lines per flow paragraph.

y07_irs_f1040_form._note: Tier `unsupported`, refused, so geometry only -- no page count.

x10_chrome_tables_plain._note: The control. Its splits are 70% `shared baseline, too far apart` -- the documented table-cell limit, a different rule at the same site -- and the diagnosis predicted no movement. It moved by nothing at every point of the constant sweep.

magnitude_against_the_predicted_bounds.y06_blocks: 12878 -> 12254, against a reference of 4203. Stage 1 closes 7% of that distance.
magnitude_against_the_predicted_bounds.reading: Small, and expected to be. The diagnosis attributes the bulk of the shattering to `no horizontal overlap` (2140 splits on the y06 sample) rather than to the pitch gate (491), and the overlap term is upstream of the pitch. Stage 2 is where the root is addressed.

reference_arm_did_not_move.method: _build_blocks, _build_blocks_one, _column_split and _pitch_reference wrapped with counters, then the full parse+infer path run on the PyMuPDF arm over all six signature documents.
reference_arm_did_not_move.why: parse.py takes blocks straight from MuPDF's structured-text analysis; this module is never imported into that path.

gate._note: testkit/runall.py, both lanes, in the canonical container. Both lanes run the PyMuPDF backend -- the shipping one -- so this is a proof that a candidate-arm change did not leak, not a measurement of the candidate.

candidate_arm_ir._note: Where a pdfium-side block change would actually show. Blocks/paras per document, before -> after, candidate arm. 14 of 16 are unchanged.

01_whitepaper_market.reading: blocks move 22 of the way toward the reference; the Para count was already equal to the reference and stayed there

02_research_paper.reading: blocks move toward the reference. The Para count moves one FURTHER below it: joining blocks removes a paragraph boundary, and this document's candidate count was already under the reference. Reported rather than waived -- it is one Para on a document the diagnosis already lists as differing slightly.

l1_word_native._note: Unmoved by this stage. Recorded because the diagnosis names it as the one gated document whose Para count differs (4 -> 8), and that difference is unchanged here. Its block count measures 12 on this instrument at BOTH before and after, where the diagnosis's blast-radius table records 10; the discrepancy is in the transcription, not in this change, since the before-run reproduces every other figure in that table exactly.

tests._note: 500 at tip plus 17. The threshold tests pin the measured gated populations on both sides; the guard tests pin the fallback order and assert the only-ever-raises property over a grid; the assembly tests run the real _build_blocks and include the premise (that the polluted page really does compute an impossible pitch) rather than assuming it.

instrument_caveats: The `before` arm is the same tree with PITCH_FLOOR_EM set to 0.0 rather than a separate checkout. That makes _pitch_reference return `by_size.get(size, typical)` -- textually the expression it replaced -- and the constant sweep confirms it reproduces the pre-change block and Para counts on all six signature documents.

`paras` counts FLOW paragraphs only. Table-cell paragraphs are counted separately, because a cell holds one short Para by construction and including them dilutes the lines-per-para signal. The reference figures in `signature_documents_candidate_arm` reproduce the diagnosis's blast-radius table exactly on this definition, which is how the instrument was validated before any change was made.
